headline: Chutzpah
summary: “Life is either a daring adventure or nothing at all.”

headline: Out of the ordinary
summary: “I think we forget things if we have no one to tell them to.”

headline: Lessons drawn
summary: “Life is a succession of lessons which must be lived to be understood.”

headline: Larger-than-life
summary: “You don’t always need a plan. Sometimes you just need to breathe, trust, let go, and see what happens.”

headline: Cheerio
summary: “Don’t cry because it’s over, smile because it happened.”

headline: Artistic Connotations
summary: “A tale may have exactly three beginnings: one for the audience, one for the artist, and one for the poor bastard who has to live in it.”

headline: Inflated Indifference
summary: “You don’t stop laughing when you grow old, you grow old when you stop laughing.“

headline: Literary Extravaganza
summary: “Literature is where I go to explore the highest and lowest places in human society and in the human spirit, where I hope to find not absolute truth but the truth of the tale, of the imagination and of the heart.”

headline: Fixated
summary: ‘We will only grow as big as we dream that’s why we must dream big.’
